new_results.statement: For an exact-rank-three core with two disjoint rank-two source banks G,H, least positive frame eigenvalues g,h, kernel-normal separation eta, and internal normalized leverages <=1/2 in each bank, ||p_Q||_infinity <=12[(g+h)gh eta]^(-1/3).

For a rank-two source bank G and one disjoint physical row u_i with grouped volume delta_i=det([u_i,W_G])^2>0, ||p_Q||_infinity<105 delta_i^(-1/2), uniformly in outside conditioning and induced affine terms.
delta_i=pdet(S_G)(n_G.u_i)^2 and sum_{i in H} delta_i=pdet(S_G)n_G^T S_H n_G >=g^2 h eta, with the symmetric companion identity.

required_claude_application.equation: Combined bank leverages <=1/2 and det(S_G+S_H)>=(g+h)gh eta imply ||p_Q||_infinity<=12[(g+h)gh eta]^(-1/3).

designated_partner.application: Rescaled the r21 scalar/receiver split to a single original physical row plus a rank-two original-product projection bank; near-null and non-small scalar branches give the delta_i-dependent bound.

newer_source_consumed.effect: Near-diffuse rank-at-least-three physical cross blocks and two-large-directions plus collective-tail cross blocks are paid supporting branches; weak-tail/high-leverage states remain explicit.

first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-O3-TWO-RANK2-COHEAVY-AGGREGATE-ROUTING-v1: at fixed quantitative g,h,eta, pay or repartition states with an internal leverage >1/2 and all single-row grouped determinants small; otherwise exhibit a source-valid co-heavy/diffuse-transverse obstruction. Weak-bank, near-parallel-kernel, and arbitrary-extra-spectrum descent remain separate debts. The top-level end-to-end gate remains N3(tau,C0).
